# blacklight

**Tag**: data

## 简介

Blacklight is an open source Solr user interface discovery platform.
    You can use Blacklight to enable searching and browsing of your
    collections. Blacklight uses the Apache Solr search engine to search
    full text and/or metadata.

## 官网

- 主页: http://projectblacklight.org/
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/projectblacklight/blacklight
- 问题追踪: http://jira.projectblacklight.org/jira/secure/Dashboard.jspa
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/blacklight
